localChanges: With ?interface=new, a city at size 10 without an Aqueduct says "Needs an Aqueduct" in its banner's tooltip, its city screen and City Status, in place of the turns until a growth that won't happen (#781).

log: CityGrowth's `limit` data is `{ size: 10, needs: 'Aqueduct' }` for a city at size 10 without an Aqueduct, so a renderer can say so in place of counting turns to a growth the Grow rule undoes (civ-clone/web-renderer#781). The rule and the data share `lib/growthLimit`. Requires core-data-object 0.1.16 for `typeNameOf`.
test: a city past 10 that loses its Aqueduct is capped again
